evidence.why: Hand-rolled regex-based SVG sanitiser instead of a real sanitiser like DOMPurify; regex tag/attribute stripping is well known to be bypassable (nested tags, malformed markup, unusual whitespace/encoding) allowing script execution in served SVG
Relies solely on the custom bypassable sanitizer before persisting and later serving the SVG as image/svg+xml
Uploaded SVG served with image/svg+xml content type from app origin; mitigated partially by CSP header but sanitisation upstream is not a recognized sanitiser

controls_present: filename allowlist regex to prevent path traversal
file size and MIME type validation
